topic: Leg pain when walking that eases when you sit (spinal stenosis)

slides.headline: Legs ache walking, ease when you sit?
slides.sub: One common reason, and why walking often still helps.

slides.title: One common pattern
slides.body: Aching, heaviness or tingling in the buttocks or legs that builds as you walk and eases when you sit or lean forward is often linked to narrowing around the nerves in the lower back.

slides.title: Why leaning forward helps
slides.body: Bending forward opens the space around the nerves a little. That's why leaning on a shopping trolley or sitting down often brings relief within a few minutes.

slides.title: Walking is still worthwhile
slides.body: Walking in shorter bouts with rest breaks, or cycling on a stationary bike, keeps you fit without pushing through big symptoms. Many people gradually build their distance this way.

slides.title: Strength and flexibility help
slides.body: Current guidelines suggest exercise as a first step. Building hip and leg strength, trunk control and gentle forward-bending stretches can make daily walking and standing more comfortable over time.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: See a doctor promptly for numbness around the groin, changes in bladder or bowel control, or weakness that is getting worse. Leg pain from poor circulation can feel similar, so get it assessed.

slides.headline: Want to walk further?
slides.body: Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios assess your back, hips and walking, then build a program to help you walk with more comfort. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Legs aching when you walk, but easing as soon as you sit down?

That pattern is often linked to narrowing around the nerves in the lower back, sometimes called spinal stenosis. Leaning forward, like on a shopping trolley, usually opens up a bit more space and brings relief.

The good news: current guidelines suggest exercise as a first step. Walking in shorter bouts with rests, cycling, and building hip and leg strength can make daily life more comfortable. Numbness in the groin, bladder or bowel changes, or worsening weakness need a doctor promptly.

story.headline: Legs tire walking, ease sitting?
